versions.changelog:
- Removed documentation file skill-card.md.
- No functional changes; this update involves only the removal of auxiliary documentation.
- The skill's features, structure, and usage remain unchanged.

All-Industry Officers (AIO) skill version 1.0.0 — initial release:

- Provides a universal functional framework for any industry or organization, powered by 15 domain-level agent teams and 375 unique identities.
- Includes 125 modular capability units, each with identity stacking, information card display, and integrated pipeline orchestration.
- Supports both "naturally universal" (HR, finance, administration, IT) and "generalized business flow" (10 operational streams) functional layers.
- Offers dynamic industry/organization calibration, multi-agent collaboration perception, strict execution/display protocols, and flexible delivery modes (standard, read-only, no-write).
- Ships with comprehensive reference docs: unit catalog, atomic requirements, 15 domain exemplars, pipeline templates, and a full dependency knowledge graph.
- Usable out-of-the-box for all major organization task types; supports custom calibration without modifying the core skill files.
